mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aup_attachment (aup_id, file_id, file_name, created_by, deleted, created_at) VALUES (#{aupId}, #{fileId}, #{fileName}, #{createdBy}, #{deleted}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM aup_attachment WHERE aup_id = #{aupId} AND file_id = #{fileId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM aup_attachment WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM aup_attachment WHERE aup_id = #{aupId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_attachment WHERE aup_id = #{aupId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE aup_attachment SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
